ayahs.tr: By the fig and the olive

ayahs.ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ
ayahs.tr: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
ayahs.tl: Laqad khalaqnal insaana fee ahsani taqweem

ayahs.tr: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
ayahs.tl: Thumma ra dad naahu asfala saafileen

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ
ayahs.tr: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
ayahs.tl: Ill-lal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati; falahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon

ayahs.tr: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
ayahs.tl: Fama yu kaz zibuka b'adu bid deen

ayahs.tr: Is not Allah the most just of judges?
